$comment: Declared outputs for requirements-doc (D0235 A3: declared = built and checked). An output may appear under `declared` ONLY when its generator and its read-back checks exist and pass in scripts/render.py — which LOADS this file and derives its A5.2 assertions from fieldMap (issue005). readback: 'text' = asserted in extracted text on every render; 'golden' = covered by the pixel baseline (runs under --check/--update-golden for baselined instances only); 'none' = declared omission.

pdf.checks: scripts/render.py: schema validation; token-level content-contract gate; glyph coverage; zero-warnings compile; fieldMap-driven text read-back; golden visual diff (--check/--update-golden, baselined instances); hex lint

fieldMap.note: optional; row omitted entirely when absent (author ruling 2026-08-27); asserted only when present

pending.xlsx: requirements-matrix via openpyxl (task xlsxMatrixGenerator); content field downgrades to plain text - declared here, per CONTENT-FORMAT.md
pending.docx: letter-style via python-docx; after xlsx per D0235 A3 (author may reorder)
